DIAGNOSIS READY: Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI) secondary to levofloxacin therapy.

The combination of recent fluoroquinolone use and acute onset of watery diarrhea with cramping is classic for CDI. I await your return of the C. diff toxin assay and CBC results to confirm this clinical suspicion before initiating treatment.
